t: You're at Sutton House, a Grade Two star listed Tudor manor house on Homerton High Street in Hackney, now owned by the National Trust. It was founded by Ralph Sadler, who lived here. He served Henry the Eighth as Privy Councillor, Secretary of State and ambassador to Scotland, and later served Edward the Sixth and Elizabeth the First. The house takes its name from Thomas Sutton, who founded the London Charterhouse and Charterhouse School. Thomas Belasyse, the first Earl Fauconberg, died here. He supported Parliament in the Civil War and married Oliver Cromwell's daughter Mary.
